MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Oct 8, 2026
UNSCHEDULED MAINTENANCE - OCTOBER 8, 2026

We will be performing an unscheduled maintenance starting on Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 7:00 AM PDT (10:00 AM EDT / 4:00 PM CEST / 1:00 AM AEDT October 9). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2 hours, concluding around 9:00 AM PDT (12:00 PM EDT / 6:00 PM CEST / 3:00 AM AEDT October 9).

Times:

Thursday, October 8, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 9:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +10): 1:00 AM October 9 - 3:00 AM October 9

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

Resolved an issue where the effective healing distance of Cleric's Heal skill was wider than intended.
Resolved an issue where Cleric's Heal skill could still be used without enough MP.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to connect to Channels 1, 2, 3, and 4.

MAINTENANCE
Oct 7, 2026
SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH MAINTENANCE - OCTOBER 8, 2026

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch maintenance starting on Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 11:00 PM AEDT). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 7 hours, concluding around 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT / 9:00 PM CEST / 6:00 AM AEDT October 9).

Times:

Thursday, October 8, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 12:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 9:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 11:00 PM - 6:00 AM October 9

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.
MapleStory Classic World will not be affected.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.271.4.0.
Full list of changes and updates will be updated after maintenance is complete.

items.title: maintenanceOct 5, 2026Mac OS Beta Known Issues and UpdatesClick here to find Known Issues and Updates for macOS users during the Beta service.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Oct 5, 2026
MAC OS BETA KNOWN ISSUES AND UPDATES

The macOS Beta update list focuses on all changes and updates for macOS users during the Beta service. Please check the Known Issues section below for any current issues affecting the macOS Beta, and the Updates section for what was updated and changed. Make sure to close and restart your client after an update to ensure you are on the latest build.

Known Issues:
MacOS users who have updated to macOS 27 Golden Gate are unable to access MapleStory through Steam.
We advise players to download and install MapleStory directly from the Nexon Launcher, which will prompt the Rosetta install needed to access the game. Once Rosetta is installed, MapleStory can be accessed from Steam as normal.
Some players have reported experiencing drop in FPS while playing through the macOS client.
We recommend turning off all in-game sound related settings as it may help alleviate this issue.
The macOS keyboard shortcut Cmd+M can be activated while playing with 'Auto Key Activation' enabled, causing the game client to minimize.
Updates:

October 5, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.38.
Added support for MapleStory Classic World on Nexon launcher.
Added support for MapleStory Classic World on Steam launcher.
Added Game Key Mode.

August 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.32.
MapleStory Classic World:

Resolved an issue where the top menu bar appeared in full-screen mode on certain non-widescreen monitors
Resolved an issue causing game controller malfunctions

July 14, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.31.
Minor adjustments to client stability.

July 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.30.
Resolved an issue where launching MapleStory through Steam would incorrectly display black borders.

June 17, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.28.
Updated to support Discord Connect feature for macOS.

June 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.27.
Resolved an issue where the background for the End User License Agreement was discolored when installing through Steam.
Resolved an issue where the error message for having an outdated client would not show when launching through Steam.

May 21, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.26.
Adjusted for Steam Client Support.

April 30, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.25.
Resolved an issue where a prompt would not show properly in dark mode during the first install.

April 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.24.
Resolved an issue where jumping would persist when repeating commands.
Adjusted the Dock Icon and Menu Bar.

February 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.21.
NGS will be updated to 5.3.38.0.

December 19, 2025

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.20.
Resolved an issue where there was a discrepancy with available disc space after installation

macOS Beta 更新列表汇总了 Beta 服务期间针对 macOS 用户的所有更改与更新。请查看下方“已知问题”部分，了解当前影响 macOS Beta 的问题；查看“更新”部分，了解已更新和更改的内容。更新后请务必关闭并重新启动客户端，以确保您运行的是最新版本。
